title: E-RLT-0102: the no-veto two-point store as a rule, pass under both the bounce and the pass contacts: the pair move...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0102 in the relativity arena: the no-veto two-point store as a rule, pass under both the bounce and the pass contacts: the pair move unmakes every love and fear on an empty line and stores both points; it is an involution (0 of 25,088 docks a start), reverses exactly (17 of 17), commutes with all 1,152 coin maps and C (0 off over about 9,000 distinct docks), equals the old knit bit for bit where no pair is refused (0 of 122,880 like meetings on flat links) and differs from it exactly on the docks the point veto refuses (0 against the iff); nothing reads a point, so every term and every start holds one occupation history (0 of 480 single exchanges change it); the no-veto vacuum makes and unmakes 466,944 pairs under both contacts, where the old knit makes 393,216 under the bounce and, under the pass, is unbalanced on its own classical path (about 39,500 made against 27,500 unmade).
